paragraphs.text:
Y ou see three drivers standing near their cabs. One is young, 
another is an old man, and the third is nattily dressed. Which 
will you hire? If you can successfully make a Psychology or a 
Spot Hidden roll then go to 15 first, then choose. 
For the young driver, go to 179; for the old driver, go to 201; 
for the well-dressed driver, go to 223. 
(81, 131, 201)
